message: CLI runtime/model shorthand uses configured aliases and origin-aware model defaults; factory selection preserves specialist routing. Verified with launcher, auth, preflight, setup, and release fixtures.

Qwen and Devstral are configurable local aliases. Both passed live shell-tool probes under default factory policy; restricted standalone probes failed escalation handling. Records preserve that limit. Source and installed runtime match; no publication performed.

Added optional Nightshift advisory commands and architecture/UX planning inputs; keep consultations outside factory admission and engineering gates, and keep BMad optional. Grounded in commands/nightshift-help.md and scripts/nightshift-factory.sh.

Separate terminal verbosity from explain investigation depth: default concise, configurable verbose/quiet, private full logs, scoped brief explanations. Verified in tests/test-output.py and factory fixtures.
Added explicit nightshift init instead of agent-side setup on behalf of the user; configuration writes reuse setup defaults, baseline commits only selected files, no model runs.
